# db-11 — DataBall must open many files into one session

Paths, directories, globs, recursive. Each source becomes a row in a run/source dimension (path, hash, detected type, per-source meta) joined into the `"data"` view. Schema merge by default (union by name, nulls, numeric widening; other conflicts error). The caller chooses abort-all or skip-file for bad data.

**Findings:** owner interview (2026-10-08) · **Size:** L · **Tree:** databall

**2026-10-09** — From db-02 review (2026-10-08): each later file bringing a new per-source metadata key triggers another full re-split (cost ~ files x session size). Stage all sources first and split once, or use in-place dimension growth (see db-07 note). Also: a declared key column that arrives as metadata (constant in file 1) still throws 'tables.X.key ... is not in the data' in TableLayout.Build; the run key must handle this.

trust: unverified; by: Jon R

**2026-10-09** — From db-02 review (2026-10-08): layout physical types are fixed at first import and the re-split casts incoming data to existing types, which conflicts with db-11's planned numeric-widening schema merge. Decide how widening applies to layout sessions.

trust: unverified; by: Jon R

**2026-10-10** — From db-06 review (2026-10-10): native .ball import ATTACHes the source READ_ONLY for one import transaction (deferred DETACH in the store transaction) and does not consult the in-process open-file gate. Many files in one session needs a session-lifetime attachment registry through that gate, and a policy for merging several stored _databall configs (db-06 import merges only columns, relationships, tables and metadata).

trust: unverified; by: Jon R
